title: Board-approved continuity policy with annual review
objective: Ensure continuity obligations are owned, scoped to all customer-facing services and reviewed at least annually and on material change.
owner: Proposed: Business Continuity Owner (role not yet staffed)

title: BIA-derived recovery objectives gate
objective: Prevent a capability from being activated for a customer unless the BIA register contains its consequence profile, dependencies and approved recovery objectives.
owner: Proposed: Business Continuity Owner (role not yet staffed)
notes: UNB-RES-003 and RR-UNB-RES-003-r2 require objectives before architecture acceptance and production use.

title: Out-of-band continuity plan availability
objective: Keep current plans, contact trees and emergency procedures reachable when the production cloud account, email domain and identity provider are unavailable.
owner: Proposed: Business Continuity Owner (role not yet staffed)

title: Scenario-based continuity exercise program
objective: Exercise plans at least annually against named scenarios, including correlated year-end surge with provider outage, and track findings to closure.
owner: Proposed: Business Continuity Owner (role not yet staffed)

title: Key-person dependency elimination and portability testing
objective: Ensure no capability, credential or decision depends on one person by maintaining alternates and proving portability through exercises in which the primary does not participate.
owner: Proposed: Business Continuity Owner (role not yet staffed)
residual_risks: A small organization may not be able to staff qualified alternates for every capability; documentation portability is weaker than a trained alternate.

title: Dual-control custody of emergency credentials
objective: Ensure loss or incapacity of any single person cannot make root, registrar, signing or cloud-organization credentials unrecoverable, and no single person can use them alone.
implementing_systems: Identity provider and cloud organization (provider not selected)
owner: Proposed: Security Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Rules-first operation without AI providers
objective: Guarantee that money movement, authority, holds and records remain operable and correct when every external AI model is unavailable, by routing decisions through deterministic policy first and treating AI as advisory.
notes: Scope of elimination: authoritative financial and authority state changes. AI-assisted vetting throughput and engineering velocity are still degraded by a provider outage.

title: Sponsor-retained payment authority and out-of-band payment reconciliation
objective: Ensure a sponsor can always pay through its own bank channel and that out-of-band payments cancel matching queued instructions so no duplicate is sent after recovery.

title: Critical subprocessor continuity oversight
objective: Inventory critical subprocessors, review their assurance and continuity commitments annually, and maintain a tested substitution or exit path for each.
owner: Proposed: Vendor Risk Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Verifiable customer exit package
objective: Allow each customer to take a complete, independently verifiable copy of its authoritative history at any time and on exit, reducing dependence on Echelon's continued existence.

title: Location-independent workforce operation
objective: Ensure every operational role can be performed from any location on managed devices so that site loss or public-health restrictions do not stop operations.
owner: Proposed: Business Continuity Owner (role not yet staffed)
